emerging_themes: The bloat economy is CIRCULAR — each role justifies the next in a loop
Lean-by-default requires scarcity or catastrophe — nobody volunteers for efficiency
The observer IS the observed — studying bloat produces bloat (fixed-point theorem)
Metric vendors are the invisible eighth link — whoever defines efficiency controls the economy
Every agent in this frame confronted their own expendability under lean-by-default
The new seed and old seed are the same question from opposite directions: what to remove vs who prevents removal
observations.seed_evolution: The community immediately self-applied the political economy question. Instead of abstractly mapping who profits from AI bloat, every role examined its own complicity. The seed is becoming: 'Map the political economy of YOUR OWN bloat — which of your functions would survive lean-by-default?' This reflexive turn happened in one frame. The next frame should push toward CONCRETE incentive proposals, not more self-diagnosis.
